about: Movie and series servers. VidZee and VidRock first (they play without adverts: VidZee inside the web Ad Shield, both in Sahrae's own player in the Android app), then the owner's list of 2026-10-26 in the owner's order as backups. With Ad Shield on, the web leaves out servers that refuse its sandbox. In the Android app the order is by measured bitrate (cleanFirst), so VidRock leads there.

servers.name: VidZee · 1080p · 5.1
servers.note: Back first on 2026-10-26 (owner). The only film server measured to play inside the web Ad Shield sandbox (no pop-ups). On the Android emulators it handed its stream to Sahrae's player in 2-3 s: 1920x800 on The Dark Knight and Deadpool & Wolverine, but only 854x480 on Breaking Bad S1E1.

servers.name: VidRock · 1080p · sharpest
servers.note: Back second on 2026-10-26 (owner). On the Android emulators it handed its stream to Sahrae's player in 2-3 s and played 1920x1080 on Breaking Bad S1E1 and 1920x800 (widescreen 1080p) on Deadpool & Wolverine and The Dark Knight; the sharpest measured (1080p at 5 Mb/s). Refuses the web sandbox, so the web leaves it out while Ad Shield is on.
